article_manifest.title: Niger: Niger Receives 1.65m Liters of Algerian Fuel As Shortages Persist
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Niger Receives 1.65m Liters of Algerian Fuel As Shortages Persist
article_manifest.summary: Niger has received its first shipment of fuel from Algeria, with 53 tanker trucks delivering 1.65 million liters of petroleum products to the northern city of Agadez as the country seeks to ease fuel shortages and strengthen energy cooperation with its northern neighbor. The convoy arrived on October 31, 2026, under military escort from both countries, according to Niger's state broadcaster RTN.

article_manifest.title: Niger–Mali: Tiani and Goïta reaffirm their commitment to strengthening the ESA and the fight against terrorism
article_manifest.original_title: Niger–Mali : Tiani et Goïta réaffirment leur engagement à renforcer l’AES et la lutte contre le terrorisme
article_manifest.summary: The Presidents of Niger and Mali, Army Generals Abdourahamane Tiani and Assimi Goïta, reaffirmed, Thursday in Niamey, their determination to consolidate the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), to intensify the fight against terrorism and to strengthen security, diplomatic and economic cooperation between member countries This common will emerges from the joint communiqué issued at the end of the official visit to Niger by the President of Mali, at the invitation of his Nigerien counterpart .

article_manifest.title: Massive influx of gold miners from Guinea: The Malian Government takes stock of the situation It was this Thursday, during a press briefing jointly hosted by the two ministers in the conference room of the Ministry of Security, that the details of this humanitarian and security crisis were shared with the
article_manifest.original_title: Afflux massif d’orpailleurs en provenance de Guinée : Le Gouvernement malien fait le point sur la situation C’est ce jeudi, au cours d’un point de presse animé conjointement par les deux ministres dans la salle de conférence du ministère de la Sécurité, que les détails de cette crise humanitaire et sécuritaire ont été partagés avec l’opinio
article_manifest.summary: Following a decision by the Guinean authorities banning traditional and illegal gold panning on their soil, Mali is facing an influx of migrants on an unprecedented scale. Nearly 80,000 people, mostly foreign nationals representing at least six nationalities, have crossed the border at Kourémalé since 2 November Faced with this critical situation that suddenly occurred, the Malian State immediately reacted under the aegis of the Prime Minister, Chairman of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management .

article_manifest.title: Return of the Burkinabe gold miners from Guinea: the Prime Minister chairs a crisis meeting
article_manifest.original_title: Retour des orpailleurs burkinabés de Guinée : le Premier ministre préside une réunion de crise
article_manifest.summary: The Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, chaired this Thursday, November 5, 2026, a meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC). Only one subject was on the agenda: the massive arrival in Mali of Burkinabe nationals expelled from gold mining sites in Guinea . Faced with this situation, the Government activated its crisis management mechanisms.

article_manifest.title: Song-Taaba Cooperative: Biscuits to Support SDS and VDP at the Front
article_manifest.original_title: Coopérative Song-Taaba : Des biscuits pour soutenir les FDS et les VDP au front
article_manifest.summary: Originally from the Nakambé region, the "Song-Taaba" cooperative company in Tenkodogo has a great affluence. At the show, it presents a range of processed products highlighting the potential of local cereals According to the head of the Song-Taaba cooperative, based in the No.1 sector of Tenkodogo in the Nakambe region, Larba Tarnagda Nagalo, participation in this 18th edition of the Ouagadougou International Crafts Fair (SIAO) aims to promote the flavors of her region .

article_manifest.title: Gold miners from Guinea: Bamako facing the influx
article_manifest.original_title: Orpailleurs venus de Guinée : Bamako face à l’afflux
article_manifest.summary: RIGHT NOW "We are a family in Mali, but our wish is to return home," says Yacouba Sawadogo, a Burkinabe gold miner who arrived after leaving Guinea. Since 29 October, the Guinean authorities have suspended artisanal gold panning in the Siguiri region, citing environmental degradation, pollution of waterways and the use of machines incompatible with artisanal mining .

article_manifest.title: Sahel Conference urges media to drive food security accountability
article_manifest.original_title: Sahel Conference urges media to drive food security accountability
article_manifest.summary: - 2027: Gombe Pilgrims Board Chair to Lead 25-Member APC Campaign Directorate - Military rewards soldier for rejecting kidnap suspect’s bribe Also speaking, Nwuneli Okonkwo, Executive Director Sahel Consulting, called for greater integration efforts across sectors, noting that challenges relating to food, nutrition, healthcare and agriculture were interconnected.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike several terrorist positions and continue their offensive to secure the national territory
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent plusieurs positions terroristes et poursuivent leur offensive de sécurisation du territoire national
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely pursuing their mission of defending territorial integrity and protecting populations. As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, units engaged on the ground maintain sustained operational pressure against armed terrorist groups, through surveillance, intelligence, reconnaissance and targeted strikes The latest operations, conducted on 3 and 4 November 2026 in several sectors of the national territory, testify to the continuity of the military commitment and the willingness of the military authorities to leave no space for the terrorist threat .

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: in Soubo, a gold mine burned in retaliation for abuses against the Fulani, according to witnesses
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : à Soubo, une mine d’or incendiée en représailles aux exactions contre les Peuls, selon des témoins
article_manifest.summary: In a statement released on November 4, Human Rights Watch documented the September 1 JNIM attack on a gold mining site in northern Burkina Faso, which claimed the lives of 24 civilians.

article_manifest.title: Prohibited gold panning in Guinea: Bamako and Ouagadougou agree on the return of their nationals
article_manifest.original_title: Orpaillage interdit en Guinée : Bamako et Ouagadougou s'accordent pour le retour de leurs ressortissants
article_manifest.summary: Thousands of Malian and Burkinabe gold miners leave Guinea and flow back to Mali. Since the suspension of artisanal gold panning decided by the Guinean authorities in the Siguiri area, the Malian border localities have seen the arrival of convoys of people forced to return This Wednesday, November 4, 2026, Burkina Faso sent a ministerial delegation to Bamako, while Mali claims to have made arrangements to welcome and assist the people concerned.

article_manifest.title: Rejected gold miners from Guinea: the CNDH calls for the protection of migrants, especially children and young people
article_manifest.original_title: Orpailleurs refoulés de Guinée : la CNDH appelle à protéger les migrants, surtout les enfants et les jeunes
article_manifest.summary: The National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) is concerned about the arrival in Mali, since November 3, 2026, of many migrants mainly from gold mining sites in Guinea . In a communiqué published on 04 November 2026, the institution reminds the State of its obligations in terms of humanitarian assistance, based on the Malian Constitution and several international and African human rights protection texts.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Guinea: Ambassadors invited to a meeting in the context of operations in Siguiri
article_manifest.original_title: Guinée : les ambassadeurs conviés à une réunion dans le contexte des opérations à Siguiri
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, November 5 (AMAP) Guinean Foreign Minister Morissanda Kouyaté on Thursday invited heads of diplomatic missions accredited to Guinea to a meeting devoted to issues of common interest and the strengthening of international cooperation, in a context marked by the departure of foreign workers from the Siguiri region Announced in a statement dated 5 November, this meeting comes after the launch of operations against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in this region of the north-east of the country.

article_manifest.title: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara: the FAMa strike...
article_manifest.original_title: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara : les FAMa frappent...
article_manifest.summary: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara: the FAMa strike three terrorist positions in two days In a statement dated November 5, 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced two bases destroyed by precision strikes, near Koro and Sandaré, as well as a pair of terrorists on motorcycles targeted northwest of Sofara, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . The operations of surveillance, control and security of the territory continue.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Gold miners expelled from Guinea: At least four dead and a hundred sick
article_manifest.original_title: Orpailleurs expulsés de Guinée : Au moins quatre morts et une centaine de malades
article_manifest.summary: Kangaba, Nov. 5 (AMAP)– At least four people have lost their lives and a hundred more are being treated at the Kouremalé Community Health Centre (CSCOM), among thousands of gold miners expelled from gold mining sites in Siguiri, Guinea. Some of the wounded treated in this structure were hit by live ammunition .

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Kouremalé: The authorities of Faso welcome the "total and unconditional" assistance to more than 40,000 Burkinabe gold miners expelled from Guinea
article_manifest.original_title: Kouremalé : Les autorités du Faso saluent l’assistance «totale et inconditionnelle» à plus 40.000 orpailleurs burkinabè expulsés de Guinée
article_manifest.summary: Kangaba, November 5 (AMAP) The Malian authorities have mobilized their services to provide assistance to more than 40,000 Burkinabe nationals expelled from gold mining sites in Guinea and arrived in Kouremalé, in the rural commune of Benkadi . The adviser at the Embassy of Burkina Faso in Mali, Ramdé Antoine, and the delegate to the Council of Burkinabè of the Koulikoro region, Daouda Ouattara, welcomed the "total and unconditional" assistance of the Malian authorities, particularly those of Kouremalé, noted AMAP .

article_manifest.title: Mali: President Goïta endows several defence services with new rolling means
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : le président Goïta dote plusieurs services de la Défense de nouveaux moyens roulants
article_manifest.summary: On the sidelines of the commemoration of the National Day of Wards, this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Head of State, proceeded, at the Koulouba Palace, to the delivery of rolling means to several defense services .

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike terrorist bases near Koro, Sandaré and Sofara
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent des bases terroristes près de Koro, Sandaré et Sofara
article_manifest.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike terrorist bases near Koro, Sandaré and Sofara As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their allies continue to carry out missions to secure the country. The General Staff of the Armed Forces gave an update on several strikes carried out in recent days. On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, a terrorist base was spotted 52 kilometers northeast of Koro .

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces provides several defence services with new rolling means
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba : le Chef Suprême des Armées dote plusieurs services de la Défense de nouveaux moyens roulants
article_manifest.summary: Nine (9) buses and six (6) pick-ups were handed over by the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces to the Armed Forces Social Service, the Banankoro NCO School (ESO), the Military Police, the Directorate of Armed Forces Information and Public Relations (DIRPA), the Special Operations Command (COS), the Directorate of Military Sports, the Staff School, the Military Police and the Directorate of Armed Forces Music .

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: the President of the Transition offers vehicles to the Defence Services
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba : le Président de la Transition offre des véhicules aux services de la Défense
article_manifest.summary: On the occasion of the National Day of Wards this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, handed over nine buses and six pick-ups intended for the Defence Services, at the Koulouba Palace . These vehicles are intended in particular for the Social Service of the Armed Forces, the School of Non-Commissioned Officers of Banankoro, the Military Prytanée, the DIRPA, the Special Operations Command, the Military Police and the Directorate of the Music of the Armed Forces .

article_manifest.title: Thousands of Burkinabe repatriated from Guinea after measures against illegal gold panning
article_manifest.original_title: Des milliers de Burkinabè rapatriés de Guinée après des mesures contre l’orpaillage illégal
article_manifest.summary: Guinea's gold mines attract many West African nationals, including Burkinabè. But on Monday, the Guinean government announced a formal ban on artisanal gold mining in several areas in the north-east of the country, as well as the permanent deployment of defence and security forces to enforce this measure. However, the Guinean authorities have not communicated on these population movements .

article_manifest.title: Rejected gold miners from Guinea: Mali and Burkina Faso organize the return of Burkinabe
article_manifest.original_title: Orpailleurs refoulés de Guinée : le Mali et le Burkina Faso organisent le retour des Burkinabè
article_manifest.summary: Rejected miners from Guinea: Mali and Burkina Faso organize the return of Burkinabe The Malian Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine, received on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 a Burkinabe delegation led by his counterpart, the Divisional Commissioner of Police Mahamadou Sana . The Burkinabe Minister of Family and Solidarity, Lieutenant-Colonel Passowendé Pélagie Kaboré, was also part of the delegation.

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: General Assimi GOÏTA hands over a batch of vehicles to several army departments
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba : Le Général Assimi GOÏTA remet un lot de véhicules à plusieurs services des Armées
article_manifest.summary: Koulouba: the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces endows several defense services with new rolling means On the sidelines of the commemoration of the National Day of Wards, this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, His Excellency Army General Assimi GOÏTA, Head of State, proceeded, at the Palace of Koulouba, to the delivery of rolling means to several defense services .

article_manifest.title: Withdrawal of driving licences: about forty files examined
article_manifest.original_title: Retrait des permis de conduire : une quarantaine de dossiers examinée
article_manifest.summary: La Direction générale des transports terrestres et maritimes (DGTTM) a tenu la troisième session foraine de la Commission technique spéciale de retrait du permis de conduire (CTSRPC), le lundi 26 octobre 2026, à la gare routière de Boromo. L’ouverture de la session de 48h a été présidée par le haut-commissaire de la province, Martin Bado, représentant le gouverneur de la région de Bankui.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Kouremalé faced with the influx of thousands of people from Guinea
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Kouremalé face à l’afflux de milliers de personnes venues de la Guinée
article_manifest.summary: The suspension of artisanal gold panning in Siguiri prefecture, Guinea, caused the forced return of thousands of foreign gold miners, including Malians and Burkinabe. Faced with this influx, the authorities announce measures to welcome the people concerned, provide them with assistance and facilitate their return to their respective countries In a statement issued on Tuesday, November 3, the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC) ensures that arrangements are made to assist the nationals concerned and organize their return.

article_manifest.title: MILITARY COURT OF BAMAKO: eight cases considered at the correctional hearing
article_manifest.original_title: TRIBUNAL MILITAIRE DE BAMAKO : huit affaires examinées à l’audience correctionnelle
article_manifest.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at its headquarters located in Dar Salam, in the 3rd district of the District of Bamako, its ordinary correctional hearing. A total of eight (08) cases were on the docket, involving several military and civilian personnel for various acts relating to Military Justice. The hearing was presided over by Magistrate Assama DOLO, assisted by his colleagues .

article_manifest.title: In the crisis in the Sahel, a voice is seriously lacking: that of black African intellectuals
article_manifest.original_title: Dans la crise au Sahel, une voix manque gravement : Celle des intellectuels noirs africains
article_manifest.summary: Image generated by AI In this forum devoted to the security and geopolitical crisis in the Sahel, Clément Roger Yaméogo, demographer-economist and head of the firm CERYA, challenges black African intellectuals on their weak involvement in reflection and mobilization around the issues of sovereignty and economic independence of the continent. It calls for a mobilization of scientific, academic and professional skills to better understand the drivers of the crisis, enlighten the populations and contribute to the construction of an Africa master of its resources and its destiny.

article_manifest.title: Bam: the High Commissioner salutes the generosity of the CEO of Serval Sécurité towards the VDPs of Zimtanga
article_manifest.original_title: Bam : le haut-commissaire salue la générosité du PDG de Serval Sécurité envers les VDP de Zimtanga
article_manifest.summary: Bam: the High Commissioner salutes the generosity of the CEO of Serval Sécurité towards the VDP of Zimtanga Kongoussi, Oct. 31, 2026 (AIB)- The High Commissioner of the province of Bam, Karim Ouédraogo, welcomed on Friday, October 30, 2026 in Kongoussi the generosity of the President and CEO of Serval Sécurité, Harouna Sawadogo . The latter offered food, a financial envelope and security equipment to the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP) of Zimtanga, to support their commitment to securing the territory.

article_manifest.title: Mouhoun: The garrison of Dédougou commemorates the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces under the sign of sovereign defense
article_manifest.original_title: Mouhoun : La garnison de Dédougou commémore les 66 ans des Forces armées nationales sous le signe de la défense souveraine
article_manifest.summary: BURKINA-MOUHOUN-ARMEE-ANNIVERSAIRE-COMMEMORATION Mouhoun: The garrison of Dédougou commemorates the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces under the sign of sovereign defense Dédougou, Nov 1 . 2026 (AIB)-The garrison of Dédougou celebrated on Sunday, November 1, 2026, the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces (FAN) through a ceremony of taking up arms under the theme "National Armed Forces and military reserve for a sovereign defense of the Fatherland" .
